subject: ios-shell-repair GREEN 8/8 + a harness false-positive fixed + two visual findings
body: Full story for the iOS shell repair. BUILD: SUCCEEDED first try - your ~1300 never-compiled lines build clean (only a pre-existing withUnsafeBytes deprecation warning in BadgeReaderManager). The two you flagged (LockedIdle scalar=='\n', Task @MainActor on iOS 15) compiled fine. THE STEP-6 FALSE POSITIVE (the real work): step 6 (40s loopback soak) failed on EVERY run, but the app was healthy. Root cause is a self-inflicted grep: the log-capture PREDICATE filters FOR the words 'fatal'/'crash', and  echoes that predicate into the capture as a 'Filtering the log data using ...' header - so saw_fatal matched its own predicate echo, not a crash, and step 6 is the only step that checks saw_fatal. Proof the app is fine: no crash report anywhere, no fatal line, and the only termination was 'Force Quit 0xFBFBFBFB / Termination requested by simulator host' (= simctl terminate, i.e. the harness); an isolated 40s soak AND a post-batch-churn 40s soak both showed the app alive with its loopback backend call completing successfully (nw_activity ... success). Fix (one line): saw_fatal strips the 'Filtering the log data using' header before grepping; proven it still catches a real 'Fatal error:' line and no longer false-positives on a clean log. I also briefly tried hardening alive() to launchctl - that was a MISDIAGNOSIS (it regressed 5a/5b) and I reverted it; original kill -0 was fine, saw_fatal was always the bug. Result: 8/8 + everything-fast green, clean provenance, on Alpha. TWO VISUAL FINDINGS: (1) demo path shows a correct ActiveSession (Shift Operator, live 59:54 timer, End Session, app grid) - a 'Device still locked / kiosk could not be released, remains in Single App Mode' alert overlays it, which is EXPECTED and honest on a non-supervised simulator (it cannot release ASAM), not a bug. (2) a11y-extra-large lock screen scales and wraps cleanly with no overlap; ONE status line truncates: 'Unmanaged device (no managed app configuration; kiosk unavaila...' cuts off with an ellipsis at extra-large - minor (explanatory status, not a control) but real; the LockedIdle status label likely needs numberOfLines=0 or a taller container. NEGATIVE CHECK: 5a (toggle off -> no manual_login_available=true) and 5b (toggle on -> true WITH asam_probe=unavailable) both pass on the same checker, so it discriminates - not vacuous; and 5b passing proves the app reads the Settings.bundle key local_session_allowed. Device build with a team stays a note (no team configured).
